ORDER 

By the Commission: 

On June 8, 2026, Tri-City Electric Company of Iowa d/b/a Control Application & 
Maintenance, Incorporated (“Petitioner”) filed a verified Petition with the Illinois 
Commerce Commission (“Commission”) seeking to cancel its Certificate of Service 
Authority Certificate of Service Authority to install energy efficiency measures pursuant to 
Section 16-128B of the Public Utilities Act (“Act”), 220 ILCS 5/1-101 et seq. 

Petitioner was granted a Certificate of Service Authority in Docket No. 18-0088. 
The Petition states that Petitioner no longer conducts business under this company name 
and has filed a Petition for a Certificate of Service Authority using its new active business 
name, Docket No. 26-0469. There were no petitions to intervene filed. Since all facts 
necessary for the Commission to grant the requested relief are contained in the Petition, 
no hearing is necessary. 

The Commission, having considered the entire record herein and being fully 
advised in the premises, is of the opinion and finds that: 
(1) 
Petitioner, Tri-City Electric Company of Iowa d/b/a Control Application & 
Maintenance, Incorporated, was granted a Certificate of Service Authority 
to install energy efficiency measures pursuant to the requirements of the 
Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 462; 
(2) 
the Commission has jurisdiction over Petitioner and the subject matter of 
this Petition; 
(3) 
the recitals of fact set forth in the prefatory portion of this Order are 
supported by the record and are hereby adopted as findings of fact; 
(4) 
insofar as the service Petitioner offered in Illinois is offered by other energy 
efficiency installers, cancellation of Petitioner’s Certificate of Service 

26-0465 
2 

Authority will not deprive Illinois residents of any necessary service and is 
not otherwise contrary to the public interest; and 
(5) 
the Petition should be granted. 

IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED by the Illinois Commerce Commission that the 
Petition of Tri-City Electric Company of Iowa d/b/a Control Application & Maintenance, 
Incorporated to cancel the Certificate of Service Authority previously issued in Docket No. 
18-0088 is granted. 

IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that pursuant to Section 10-113(a) of the Public 
Utilities Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 200.880, any application for rehearing shall be filed 
within 30 days after service of the Order on the party. 

IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that subject to the provisions of Section 10-113 of the 
Public Utilities Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 200.880, this Order is final; it is not subject to 
the Administrative Review Law. 

By Order of the Commission this 1st day of July, 2026. 

(SIGNED) DOUGLAS P. SCOTT 

Chairman
